group.description: Model, client or service name (`other` when unknown).
group.title: Group

CostSeries.description:
Spend over time, one point per (bucket, group) with any cost. Buckets are aligned to
``bucket_seconds`` (chosen from the window: 5 min up to 1 day).
CostSeries.title: CostSeries

DataInfo.description: What the database holds: the startup sample, real recorded data, or both.
DataInfo.title: DataInfo

baseline_passed.description: null when the case is new.
baseline_passed.title: Baseline Passed

GatewaySummary.description: Per-client totals over a time window, most expensive first.
GatewaySummary.title: GatewaySummary

GatewayTurn.description: One model call through the gateway (a ``kind=llm`` span with ``source=gateway``).

failover.description: True when the request was retried on a fallback model.
failover.title: Failover

trace_id.description: The session trace this turn belongs to.
trace_id.title: Trace Id

GatewayTurn.title: GatewayTurn

as_of.description: Server time; pass it as `since` on the next live poll.
as_of.title: As Of

GuardrailEvent.description:
A block (a ``kind=guardrail`` span), a redaction (a ``lucentpad.redaction`` event) or a
budget alert (a ``lucentpad.budget.alert`` event).

count.description: redactions: how many values; blocks and budget alerts: 1
count.title: Count

GuardrailEvent.title: GuardrailEvent

GuardrailRule.description:
A blocking rule. ``prompt`` rules match the user's message (any keyword, case-insensitive,
or the regex); ``tool`` rules match a tool call by name and a condition on its arguments,
e.g. ``amount > 200`` (comparisons on argument fields; no code is evaluated).

message.description: Shown to the caller when the rule blocks.
message.title: Message

GuardrailRule.title: GuardrailRule

source.description: Where the rules came from: a file path or `built-in`.
source.title: Source

version.description: Changes whenever the rules change (for client caches).
version.title: Version

GuardrailSummary.description: Counts for a window: blocks per rule, redactions per kind.
GuardrailSummary.title: GuardrailSummary

accepted.description: Spans queued for writing (always the whole batch).
accepted.title: Accepted

IngestStats.description: Counters of the ingest pipeline since the API started.

queue_depth.description: Spans accepted but not yet written.
queue_depth.title: Queue Depth

rejected_total.description: Spans refused with 429 because the queue was full.
rejected_total.title: Rejected Total

write_errors_total.description: Spans dropped after the writer gave up retrying.
write_errors_total.title: Write Errors Total

IngestStats.title: IngestStats

checked.description: When the list prices were last checked (ISO date).
checked.title: Checked

SpanEvent.description: A point-in-time occurrence on a span, such as a failover or a budget alert.
SpanEvent.title: SpanEvent

as_of.description: Server time of this response; pass it as `since` on the next live poll.
as_of.title: As Of

spans.description: Spans ordered by start_time: all of them, or with `since` only those stored after it.
spans.title: Spans

TraceFacets.description:
Value counts per filter. Each facet's counts apply every other filter but not its own,
so ticking a value never hides its siblings. At most ``FACET_MAX_VALUES`` values per facet,
by count descending, then value.
TraceFacets.title: TraceFacets

as_of.description: Server time of this response; pass it as `since` on the next live poll.
as_of.title: As Of

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; null when there are no more traces. Valid only with the same order and filters.
next_cursor.title: Next Cursor

TraceSummary.description: One row of the traces list. Aggregates are computed over the trace's spans.

input_preview.description: The run's first user message (root span's input, else the earliest llm span's); null when capture is off.
input_preview.title: Input Preview

output_preview.description: The run's final answer (root span's output, else the latest llm span's).
output_preview.title: Output Preview

sample.description: Startup sample data (not something you recorded).
sample.title: Sample

TraceSummary.title: TraceSummary

get.description: Set `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` (Claude Code) or `COPILOT_PROVIDER_BASE_URL` with `COPILOT_PROVIDER_TYPE=anthropic` (Copilot CLI) to `<host>/gateway/anthropic`. Forwards `v1/messages`, `v1/messages/count_tokens` and `v1/models`; bodies and streams pass through unchanged. The client's key is forwarded, never stored.
